ADDED i2: An option with a long name "mf" that accepts arguments.
ADDED i3: Allow the option to hold several argument values.
ADDED i4: Supply two values: the first becomes the property key, the second its value.
ADDED i5: The two values form one key/value pair, hence a single property entry.
